location_fine: rural field with dirt embankment, military drill
visual_synopsis: A group of young men in open camouflage jackets undergo an outdoor military-style drill: roped together and marched across a field, digging into a dirt embankment, and standing in a lineup while a bearded commander in a beret and a heavyset armed man give orders and aim a rifle and shotgun. It ends with two men grappling amid laughter.
